summary: Sinks per-record-per-month feature fully tested. Backend APIs (9/9 tests passed) and Frontend UI verified via Playwright. Key functionality: creating sinks for 2 months creates 2 separate records, edit mode shows only single month, delete removes individual records.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement recommended but non-blocking
Console warning: HTML hydration error (span inside tr/tbody) - React development warning, does not affect functionality

details: POST /api/sinks accepts reporting_month (0-11) and reporting_year
Returns created sink with correct fields
Creating Jan (month=0) and Feb (month=1) creates 2 separate records with different IDs
GET /api/sinks returns records with reporting_month and reporting_year fields
PUT /api/sinks/{id} properly updates reporting_month, reporting_year, and total_emissions_reduced
DELETE removes specific sink, other sinks remain
evidence_files: [{name, url, file_id}] stored and returned correctly
Sinks without reporting_month (legacy) still work
reporting_month accepts 0 (Jan) through 11 (Dec)
Add Sink dialog shows 12 month accordions in create mode
Total counter shows sum of all monthly values (e.g., 50.5 + 75.25 = 125.75 tCO2e)
Entering data for Jan and Feb creates 2 separate rows in table
Toast: '2 sink records added successfully'
Period column shows 'Jan'2026', 'Feb'2026' format using reporting_month/reporting_year
Edit dialog shows only single month's data (e.g., 'January Offset (tCO2e)')
Not all 12 months - just the one being edited
Editing value from 50.5 to 150.0 updates table correctly
Toast: 'Sink record updated successfully'
Delete button removes individual row
Other rows remain unaffected
Each month accordion has evidence upload area in create mode

critical_code_review_comments: handleSubmit loops through monthsWithData and creates one POST per month
Edit mode correctly shows single month using editMonth state
Backend SinkCreate model has reporting_month: int field (0-11)
Evidence files stored as [{name, url, file_id}] array
seed_data_creation: Test sinks created and cleaned up during pytest. UI test created 2 sink records (Jan'2026 and Feb'2026) that may remain in database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sinks module with per-record-per-month is fully functional. Key change from previous iteration: monthly_data dict replaced with reporting_month (int 0-11) per record. Frontend creates separate POST for each month with data. Edit mode shows single month only. Period column displays 'Mon'Year' format.
